text:
amy_sales: Hi team — Customer wants an APAC-only POC (SG + SYD) with strict no-US egress. They asked for: list of subprocessors touching APAC traffic, whether we can pin a tenant to SG zone, BYOK in-region KMS option, and price delta for Dedicated in APAC. Can we confirm what's feasible and an estimated timeline?

mike_solutions: Quick answers: we can do tenant pinning to specific region pools (SG or SYD). BYOK is supported via customer KMS in a supported cloud region — need to confirm which key providers the customer will use. Pricing delta for Dedicated depends on SKU & reserved term; roughly +15-25% compared to US in our last quote. Need exact SKU to firm up.

nina_security: For subprocessors: we have a regional subset of our subproc list for APAC. I can produce an APAC-only CSV and the attestation snippet for legal. We cannot guarantee zero metadata transfer to the US if customers use the public Hosted API (traffic may route for control plane). For Private/VPC or Dedicated with tenant pinning, data plane stays in-region.

ben_eng: Ops/infra notes: Tenant pinning is configable in deployment manifest. For Dedicated we allocate a GPU pool in the target region and set routing policies. Timeline: 2–3 weeks to spin up Dedicated pool (depends on capacity). For a Private on-prem or VPC private control plane, timeline is longer (3–6 weeks).

lucy_ops: +1 to Ben. We also need customer network whitelisting and certificate exchange for BYOK KMS. If customer wants HSM-backed keys, add 1 week for key provisioning tests.

amy_sales: Thanks. Two asks from customer/legal: 1) APAC-only subprocessors CSV and an attestation statement; 2) exact pricing uplift for a 3-node Dedicated pool in SG for a 12-month term. Can someone own those?

mike_solutions: I'll take pricing — will model a 3x A10G-style node pool and include burst headroom. Expect a draft quote by EOD tomorrow.

nina_security: I'll generate the APAC subproc CSV and the attestation boilerplate. One note: some cloud infra subprocedures (IaaS, edge CDN) are global vendors; I'll flag which components may have cross-border control-plane interactions.

ben_eng: For routing policy example (what we normally hand to customer):
```
route_policies:
  - name: apac-tenant-pin
    match: tenant_id == "cust-123"
    prefer_region: ["ap-southeast-1", "ap-southeast-2"]
    failover: local_only
    allow_control_plane_proxy: false
```
This pins generation & KV cache to the SG/SYD pools. control_plane_proxy=false blocks optional control-plane fallthrough to other regions (but may impact some admin features).

lucy_ops: FYI: disabling control_plane_proxy will disable SaaS console live tracing for that tenant; we can provide logs via S3 export in-region as an alternative.

amy_sales: Good callouts. Legal also asked for DPA language referencing subprocessors by region. Nina — can you include the model clause and the CSV in the attestation?

nina_security: Yes, I'll include clause text and attach CSV. Also adding a short summary of SOC2 scope and our latest pen test date.

deploy_bot: deployment request queued: region=ap-southeast-1, pool_size=3, config=tenant-pin. ETA provisioning start: 2024-05-02 03:00 UTC (depends on capacity).

ben_eng: Note — if capacity is constrained we may propose a hybrid fallback: keep control plane in our hosted region but force data plane to APAC via VPC peering + egress rules. That reduces setup time to ~1 week but is not strictly "no-US" for control plane metadata.

amy_sales: Customer insists on no control-plane metadata outside APAC — they want full in-region control plane or Private. Can we provide a short bullets doc listing options + tradeoffs for legal? I'll send to them by tomorrow.

mike_solutions: I'll draft a 1-page options + tradeoffs doc: Dedicated pinned pools (in-region) — strongest; Private/VPC (private control plane) — strongest but longer; hybrid (fastest) — OK for many but not acceptable for strict no-control-plane-exit.

nina_security: One more: for subprocessors, our list includes monitoring providers that may have global telemetry endpoints. We'll mark them as 'requires contract addendum' where applicable.

amy_sales: Perfect. Owners: Mike = pricing + options doc; Nina = APAC subproc CSV + attestation + SOC2/pen test summary; Ben/Lucy = detailed timeline + network/KMS checklist; Ops bot shows provisioning ETA. I'll update the customer once we have the draft quote and attestation. :thumbsup:

lucy_ops: I'm adding a short checklist for the customer to speed things up:
- Confirm cloud region choices (SG / SYD)
- Provide KMS provider & key ARN if BYOK
- Provide IP ranges for whitelisting
- Sign DPA addendum (I'll send template)

amy_sales: Great — let's circle back on the morning sync. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
